audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 and Level 6 are marked 'Skill' in both layers while their own whys claim Darius: whys[2] 'Level 3 E Apprehend... your Q heal wins the trade' and whys[4] 'Level 6 R executes him before his R Let's Bounce can carry him to safety'. The 2+ item stage is marked Darius while whys[6] says Zac scales past you.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Darius x6 then Zac. The mirror audit (audits/top/zac__darius.json) independently corrected the same level-6 row on Zac's page to Darius, so both directions now agree.
audit.corrected: Level 3 and Level 6 flipped to Darius (7/10 and 7.5/10); 2+ items flipped to Zac (4/10) with phases[6].why rewritten to describe the Zac side it now asserts.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why carried a raw LaTeX fragment — 'R = d + a \times Stacks' — which renders literally on the page, and the level-6 spike never mentions the thing that actually decides it: Cell Division.
audit.why: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, and each bloblet only carries a percentage of Zac's max Health, Armor and Magic Resistance — true damage ignores all of it. But on fatal damage Zac splits into 4 bloblets and revives off whatever survives, so the execute is not the end of the fight.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten without the LaTeX and around the true-damage-vs-bloblet-resistances point; spikes[1] now states the revive and tells you to clear the blobs.
sources: enemyKit P text (4 bloblets, percentage of max Health/Armor/MR)

audit.whatIsWrong: The tldr is fabricated flavour — 'pull his flight path mid-air to break his elastic slingshot engages... smash his 4 cellular passives'. Nothing in the kits supports interrupting Elastic Slingshot mid-flight, and 'his 4 cellular passives' is a garbled reading of the 4 bloblets. Separately, spikes[1] writes his ultimate as 'Let's Bounce' (the packet already flagged this) — the ability is Let's Bounce!.
audit.why: The real interactions the page misses: Cell Division sheds a reabsorbable chunk every time an ability hits, so the sustain is denied by standing on the chunks; Unstable Matter deals a percentage of your maximum health as magic damage on a 5s cooldown, so HP stacking feeds it; Stretching Strikes grabs from 800 range and throws you into a second target; Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s while Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0], report[5], dosFull[0], dosFull[1], dontsFull[0], dontsFull[1], dontsFull[2] and spikes[1] rewritten around those verified mechanics; the ultimate is spelled Let's Bounce! everywhere it appears in edited text.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, ranges and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown reference is qualitative — 'His engage. Punish the cooldown.' — and the page implies Zac's engage cooldown is the long one you can wait out.
audit.why: Restating the mirror's finding from this side: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 and Apprehend is 26s at rank 1, so at equal ranks his engage comes back before your pull does. He can afford to trade E for E; you cannot.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1] and report[5] now carry both numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization is the generic Stridebreaker / Sterak's / Dead Man's line with no Grievous Wounds, into a champion whose passive heals him off every ability hit and revives him.
audit.why: Two _missing rules fire: 'needs-antiheal' (Cell Division) and 'resistances-invalidated' (Cell Division + Unstable Matter). Unstable Matter is percent-max-health magic damage, so buying health to survive him raises the damage he does to you.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling moved to first, and the percent-max-health point stated so the player understands why HP alone is not the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three Do/Don't cards have titles that do not match their bodies: 'Step on his blobs' explains his engage cooldown, 'Anti-heal his sustain' and 'Extend into his Q pull' both carry copy-pasted tradeGood/tradeBad text.
audit.why: The mirror audit found the identical generator-wide pattern on Zac's page (its point 12) — same template, same mismatch, opposite direction.
audit.corrected: Each body re-pointed at its own title.

notes: Mirror reused rather than re-derived: the Decimate outer-blade-heals point and the Apprehend-26s-vs-Slingshot-21s comparison both come from audits/top/zac__darius.json and are now stated from this side, so the two pages agree. Level 6 is Darius on both pages after this. The mirror explicitly declined to assert whether Cell Division's bloblet state denies Noxian Guillotine its kill-refresh — I have kept that silence, so no edit here claims an R reset off the bloblet kill. Also unstated because it is not in the kits: whether Apprehend can pull Zac out of Elastic Slingshot mid-flight (the old tldr claimed exactly this and it is now gone rather than replaced with the opposite claim). Packet defect confirmed: spikes[1] wrote 'Let's Bounce' for Let's Bounce!.
